text:
ida: FYI I pushed orbit-dense-6b-lite int6 to staging for embeddings bring-up. Quick eval shows recall@10 drop on short queries (<6 tokens). Anyone free to help triage?
rohit: Which bucket? short queries only or overall?
maria: I ran the quick holdout, here's embed-bot output:
embed-bot: /eval results: model=orbit-dense-6b-lite-int6 | dataset=shortquery-holdout | recall@1=0.54 recall@10=0.71 baseline=fp16-orbit 0.65/0.86 | mean_cosine_shift=-0.083 | mean_norm_shift=-0.12
sam: Hmm big mean_norm_shift. Did we normalize after quant? Serving path does L2 normalise but training used layernorm pooling.
ida: Good point. Serving uses L2 by default. I forgot to set pooling=layernorm in the serving config.
rohit: Can you re-run with pooling=layernorm and prefix_cache disabled?
maria: I'll kick off an eval job. Command:
```bash
./eval_embeddings.py --model orbit-dense-6b-lite-int6 --holdout shortquery-holdout --k 10 --pooling layernorm --disable-prefix-cache --seed 123
```
embed-bot: Job queued: http://logs.internal/eval/4332109876
sam: Also compare float16 baseline with same pooling to rule out quant noise.
ida: If layernorm fixes it we should add a pre-deploy check to assert pooling parity between train/serve.
rohit: Agreed. Also add a small clustering sanity: silhouette on holdout > 0.23 else block canary.
maria: quick note — short queries are dominated by stopwords; we should filter those in the eval set or test token-length stratification.
ida: Thanks. I'll watch the job and post results here.
embed-bot: Job finished: recall@10=0.83 (pooling=layernorm) mean_norm_shift=-0.02 silhouette=0.27
ida: Nice — looks like pooling mismatch was the culprit. Moving forward: add pooling parity check + seed=3 reruns.
sam: I'll add the check to the onboarding checklist and a unit test in model-bridge.
rohit: Great work, flagging for prod rollout once reserved perf tests pass :thumbsup:
